report.summary: Both UI tests fail at the same step: they click get_by_test_id("add-books"), but the Add button in app/templates/books.html:9 is data-testid="add-book". The locator in tests/support/pages.py:44 is a test bug, so fix it first to "add-book" and rerun both tests. No product or infrastructure fault is shown.

causes.title: BooksPage.add clicks a test id that does not exist in the template
causes.explanation: BooksPage.add() clicks get_by_test_id("add-books"), but the Add book button is rendered with data-testid="add-book". Playwright waits for an element that never appears and times out after 5000 ms before any assertion runs. Both tests fail inside the shared page-object helper, so the same typo breaks every caller of add(). The app is behaving correctly, and the test is wrong about the element's id.
evidence: Playwright call log: "waiting for get_by_test_id(\"add-books\")" for both tests (Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded)
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:13 and :42 both call books.add(...), which reaches pages.py:44
causes.suggested_fix: In tests/support/pages.py line 44, change get_by_test_id("add-books") to get_by_test_id("add-book"). Rerun tests/ui/test_books_ui.py. Consider also checking other page objects for similar id typos. Note that the second test's later assertions (error text, retained input, no row created) are not yet verified and could still fail once the click works.
